title: Ayushmann Khurrana shares how Indian Idol 2 rejection shaped his journey
text:
Ayushmann Khurrana shares how Indian Idol 2 rejection shaped his journey 
 Home / Entertainment / Bollywood News / Article / Ayushmann Khurrana recalls being rejected from Indian Idol 2 in 2006 
 Ayushmann Khurrana recalls being rejected from Indian Idol 2 in 2006
 Updated On: 14 November, 2026 07:47 AM IST | Mumbai | Upala KBR 
 Ayushmann Khurrana recalled being rejected in the early rounds of Indian Idol 2 in 2006 during an upcoming episode of Indian Idol Legends Return. Reflecting on his journey, the actor said success depends on several factors and people
 Listen to this article : Ayushmann Khurrana on the show. Pics/By Special Arrangement, Youtube
 Today, Ayushmann Khurrana may be one of the most bankable actors of his generation. But if things had worked out differently, we might have known Khurrana as a singer, not an actor. Shooting for an upcoming episode of Indian Idol Legends Return, the actor — who was joined by Yeh Prem Mol Liya filmmaker Sooraj Barjatya and co-star Sharvari — recalled that he was rejected in the early rounds of Indian Idol 2 in 2006.
 After singer Amit Sana played Khurrana’s audition reel, the actor reflected, “I was rejected from Indian Idol. Success is multifactorial; there are so many people who contribute to it.”
